provenance: All layer coordinates, typography tokens, colors and tweens are proposed adaptation defaults unless separately marked as measured evidence. Still images do not prove motion.

coordinateSystem.landscapeStatus: proposed adaptation, no landscape reference audit

signature.semanticTrigger: Một đoạn mở yên, mở cửa sổ hình dần theo chiều dọc.

layers.instruction: Animate mask height, không scale footage; radius đề xuất 20px ở short edge 720.

coverage.warning: One signature scene is parameterized per package. Implement and inspect other layouts explicitly; this is not full renderer coverage.

cut-hold.hold: until next semantic cue; stable geometry

window-open.interpolation: linear between measured samples as approximation; original curve unknown

captionRules.highlight: one meaningful word/span only; stable font size and position through the cue
captionRules.neverSplit: a proper name, negation or short inseparable phrase purely to fill a row
captionRules.fit: measure with the actual loaded font; rewrap or move before shrinking; ensure all marks remain visible
captionRules.collision: Move the group away from face/mouth/hands and platform UI; proposed rects are not guarantees.

timelineRules.assetSlots: Map a/b/c to registered asset IDs in the beat; these must also appear in beat.assetIds for reuse checks.
timelineRules.hold: until explicit exit cue; entry + latest stagger + readable hold + exit must fit inside beat
timelineRules.playbackDirection: forward unless reversed motion is verified and explicitly requested
timelineRules.footageTransform: Use measuredFootageTransforms as source evidence; choose explicit new cue/duration. Do not apply camera scale to text/cards.
timelineRules.assetExit: clear the complete group before the next concept; do not recycle it under another sentence

audioCuePolicy.optionalCue: one quiet cue for a meaningful layout change, after listening and checking the license

implementationChecks: No missing glyphs or font substitution.
No one-frame caption holes, re-entry on emphasis, or unintentional scale resets.
Source trims preserve meaning, breaths and final consonants; listen across joins.
Compare entry, hold and exit on a short render at normal speed.
Verify separate portrait/landscape compositions, mask edges and face clearance.

measuredGeometry.method: Thresholded visible image bounds, not recovered original masks or asset dimensions.

samples.qualification: Thresholded visible content within the window region; dark edges and rounded corners may under-estimate the actual matte.
